description: Send your program name and error message. Chaprola will read your source, intent file, and data schema to diagnose and fix the problem. See POST /help for examples.

error.description: Error message from compile or runtime (copy verbatim if available)

request.description: Plain-language description of the problem. Include context: what changed, what you expected, what happened instead.

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.
